::: {#def-indicator-variable}
#### Indicator variable

An **indicator variable** is a
[dummy variable](#def-dummy-variable) whose only values are 0 and 1.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
#### Source

@dobson4e [sec. 2.4].
:::

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

::: {#exm-indicator-sex}
#### Indicator variables for chromosomal sex

In @exm-dummy-sex,
$M$ and $F$ are indicator variables:
each takes only the values 0 and 1.
A dummy variable that uses the values $-1$ and $1$
(@rem-dummy-other-codings) is not an indicator variable.

:::
